title: Baseline, Safety Rails, and Migration Boundary
problem: A shell rewrite cannot begin safely while clean build/test, visual, route, save, and bundle baselines are incomplete or environment-blocked.
objective: Re-establish a correctly provisioned baseline; create UI-only migration control, deterministic fixture capture, route-coverage check, and progress ledger before production UI changes.
tests: Clean install; all current typechecks/tests/build/bundle/smoke/release gates; save fixture hash; 79-route resolution; baseline screenshots/geometry.
rollback: Remove UI-only flag/harness additions; no simulation or save data changes.
done: Baseline ledger records command outputs; route count is 79/79; migration mode defaults to legacy; no save schema changes.

title: Semantic Tokens and Typography Foundation
problem: Current pixel-heavy, border-heavy styling cannot express a calm hierarchy consistently.
objective: Add Broadcast War Room semantic tokens, resilient typography roles, density variables, contrast tests, and strict accent/surface rules without restyling legacy screens accidentally.
tests: Computed token/contrast tests; network-blocked font fallback; 200% zoom sample; no legacy snapshot change outside migration boundary.
rollback: Remove v2 imports; legacy tokens remain untouched.
done: Tokens document role/contrast; body/data/pixel roles enforced; new-shell examples pass phone/desktop visual review.

title: Adaptive Viewport and Screen-Archetype Primitives
problem: Width-only responsive overrides and permanent fixed clearances produce nested scroll and poor short-height behavior.
objective: Create safe-area, dynamic-height, scroll-owner, sticky-action, compact-height, rail/sidebar, and pane primitives used by every new screen archetype.
tests: 320×568 through 1600×1000; 375 px height; safe-area emulation; one-scroll-owner assertion; focused element not obscured.
rollback: New primitives are isolated and removable before shell adoption.
done: All archetype demo states have no unintended overflow/occlusion and expose measured layout mode.

title: Interaction, Focus, Dialog, and Accessibility Foundation
problem: New components would reproduce inconsistent control states, undersized targets, and overlay focus behavior without a shared interaction layer.
objective: Implement/upgrade v2 Button, tabs/links, state frame, sheet/dialog, focus ring, reduced motion, live status, and form conventions.
tests: Keyboard-only stories; focus trap/restore; Escape; target geometry; axe; reduced motion; 200% zoom; screen-reader names/states.
rollback: V2 exports coexist with legacy components; remove imports to roll back.
done: Every interactive state in 06 spec has tests; no core target under 44 px; focus is visible/unobscured.

title: Route-Surface Metadata and Deep-Link Compatibility
problem: The 79-route registry describes destinations but not future hubs, surface types, canonical paths, local tabs, return behavior, or compatibility.
objective: Create a UI adapter over the canonical engine registry that accounts for 79/79 paths and resolves old links into the new IA without changing engine route contracts.
tests: 79/79 registry parity; old path resolution; unlock/phase fixtures; entity/query preservation; return origin; no circular mappings.
rollback: Adapter can be bypassed; canonical registry remains untouched.
done: Coverage script fails any missing/duplicate route; old paths remain functional; no route is deleted.

title: App Shell Decomposition and Migration Host
problem: App.tsx concentrates routing, shell, overlays, lifecycle, and companion behavior in 2,229 lines.
objective: Extract a thin MfdAppShell and migration host while preserving current route mounting, hash routing, lifecycle effects, and legacy shell behind the UI-only mode.
tests: Legacy mode pixel/behavior smoke; new empty shell at full viewport matrix; route mounting; lifecycle effect parity; GitHub Pages base path.
rollback: Set mode to legacy or revert extraction commits; no screen migration required.
done: App.tsx becomes composition-oriented; legacy still works; new shell has one scroll owner and no permanent Chip clearance.

title: Adaptive Navigation, Wayfinding, and Return-to-Task
problem: Four phone feature links plus an overloaded More drawer do not represent the new job-centered IA.
objective: Implement Today/Team/Game/Office/League adaptive navigation, expanded Dynasty/System entries, local location labels, origin restoration, and power search integration.
tests: Five destinations at compact; rail/sidebar adaptation; labels/active/badges; 44/48 targets; core loop without search; origin/scroll/focus restoration.
rollback: Legacy bar remains in legacy shell; new navigation removable behind mode.
done: No all-route More drawer in new shell; five jobs stable at every viewport; Dynasty/System deliberately reachable.

title: Overlay and Notification Orchestration
problem: Tutorial, achievements, ceremonies, news, halftime, lore, recap, era prompts, save reminders, and dialogs mount independently and can compete.
objective: Centralize transient presentation in a deterministic priority/dedupe queue with one blocking overlay, focus management, persistence rules, and durable destinations.
tests: Synthetic collision ordering; dedupe; preemption; modal focus; toast live region; reduced motion; reload/resume rules.
rollback: Route existing overlay mounts through a compatibility bridge; bridge can restore legacy direct mounting.
done: Only one exclusive overlay appears; nonblocking stack is bounded; every event has a durable follow-up destination.

title: Chip Presentation Adapter
problem: Chip’s useful guidance currently reserves up to 320 px bottom or 370 px right and duplicates task messaging.
objective: Preserve Chip art/personality/event wiring while replacing the dock with a labeled trigger and task/context-driven sheet/panel adapter.
tests: Collapsed/expanded/muted; no layout reservation; sheet/panel focus; task consistency; dedupe; modal coexistence; route-beat/event parity.
rollback: Compatibility adapter can render legacy dock under legacy mode.
done: Chip never permanently pads content; can minimize/mute/reopen; same task source as Today/readiness.

title: Canonical Task Ledger and Today Screen
problem: Briefing, Action Center, Inbox, badges, Chip, and Advance independently compete to define what matters.
objective: Create a pure derived Task Ledger/presenter and replace Monday Briefing in new mode with the bounded Today archetype.
tests: Phase fixtures; task dedupe/priority/completion; 390×844 first viewport; ≤2.5 viewports default; return focus; no mutations; legacy parity for blockers.
rollback: Legacy MondayBriefing remains mounted in legacy mode; presenter additions are pure.
done: One task source drives Today/nav/Chip/readiness; first viewport contract passes; no feature data deleted.

title: Readiness and Week-Advance Integration
problem: Advance is treated as a route/action without one concise, trustworthy blocker/warning/consequence checkpoint.
objective: Unify readiness with the Task Ledger, provide actionable sheet/panel and exact transition labels, then preserve existing advance/game mutations behind a presenter boundary.
tests: Blocked/warning/ready/stale/save-failure fixtures; exact task destinations; acknowledgement; mutation parity; deterministic before/after state.
rollback: Existing WeekAdvance route remains compatibility destination; new control delegates to existing actions.
done: Advance label states real transition; blockers actionable; warnings explicit; no UI-only bypass of game rules.

title: Entry and Guided Setup Reinvention
problem: New Game is six phone screens and 56 controls before commitment.
objective: Stage title/continue/start type/franchise/experience/review into bounded steps, preserving existing creation logic and Chip onboarding.
tests: No/one/multiple save; Guided/Instant/Scenario/Import; back preserves; step ≤1.5 viewports; storage error/recovery; keyboard/touch.
rollback: Legacy entry/setup retained behind migration mode until H1.
done: Primary start choices in first viewport; setup progress/restoration works; creation outputs identical save contracts.

title: Team Hub and Mobile-Native Roster
problem: Team systems are scattered and Roster reaches fourteen phone screens through generic card conversion.
objective: Create Team hub and purpose-built responsive Roster collection with position groups, prioritized fields, filters, compare tray, and preserved entity origin.
tests: 53/expanded roster fixtures; filters/sort/group; phone priorities; virtualization threshold; player return; 320/390/tablet/desktop; compact/coarse pointer.
rollback: Old `/roster` wrapper remains available through compatibility mapping.
done: Roster is bounded and scannable; no generic all-field cards; all existing roster actions reachable.

title: Player Entity Detail and Comparison
problem: Player drill-down and comparison do not share a consistent entity/local-tab/origin model.
objective: Create canonical player detail tabs and comparison flow preserving roster/task/trade origins.
tests: Roster/depth/trade/stat origins; injured/prospect/retired/practice states; tab deep links; comparison; focus/scroll restoration.
rollback: Compatibility wrapper renders legacy profile when new presenter unsupported.
done: One canonical player entity; all old player actions/history accounted for; return origin exact.

title: Depth, Development, Staff, and Culture Surfaces
problem: Core team-preparation and people systems remain separate route-style pages with inconsistent mobile workflows.
objective: Migrate Depth, development, coaching/staff, locker room/culture, mentors, commitments, and practice squad into Team sections and workflows.
tests: Incomplete/conflict/injury depth; no drag-only path; development/staff/culture states; task completion; route compatibility.
rollback: Cluster routes retain legacy wrappers individually.
done: All Team matrix rows green; required depth task round-trip passes phone/desktop.

title: Office Finance, Contracts, Ownership, and Operations
problem: Contracts, Cap Lab, Front Office, owner, facilities/operations, and governance signals lack one finance/ownership question model.
objective: Create Office hub Finance/Operations/Ownership sections with summary-first data and safe scenario/contract workflows.
tests: Healthy/over-cap/expirations/owner warning; scenario cancel/no mutation; contract actions; mobile priorities; old-path aliases.
rollback: Legacy finance routes remain wrappers; scenarios remain UI-only until commit.
done: Finance questions have canonical surfaces; every current action and cap consequence preserved.

title: Trade Desk and Personnel Workbench
problem: Trades, block, deadline, and needs are fragmented and difficult to operate on phone.
objective: Build phase-aware Trade Desk with needs context, asset selection, cap/value consequence, preserved draft offer, and accessible staged phone workflow.
tests: Empty/invalid/counter/accepted/deadline; no drag-only; cap/roster parity; preserve draft; old routes; deterministic outcome/action parity.
rollback: Existing trade actions remain source; new workbench delegates and can be disabled.
done: Deadline journey completes within Office; all trade/block/needs capabilities accounted for.

title: Scouting, Draft, Free Agency, Waivers, and Camp
problem: The offseason is a sequence of independent global destinations rather than one lifecycle.
objective: Create phase-aware Personnel lifecycle with scouting/draft/FA/waiver/camp workbenches and event transitions while preserving every existing rule/action.
tests: All lifecycle phases; on-clock/trade offer/pick/recap; FA offer outcomes; waiver/camp; route aliases; save/determinism parity.
rollback: Phase sections can fall back route-by-route to legacy components.
done: Offseason can be completed as one coherent workflow; every matrix row green.

title: Game Hub and Unified Game Center
problem: Preparation and one game’s broadcast, presentation, plays, flow, film, recap, and schedule context are fragmented.
objective: Create Game Hub and canonical game-ID Game Center with local tabs, persistent score/context, pre/live/post states, and old-route aliases.
tests: Pregame/live/halftime/final/replay; tab deep links; no game-context loss; phone landscape/touch; reduced motion; old route resolution; game outcome parity.
rollback: Each old game route remains a compatibility wrapper to legacy/new tab.
done: One game ID carries every view; start/review/return loop passes; no simulation changes.

title: League Hub and Dense Data Patterns
problem: League feeds/data overlap and dense screens lack question-specific mobile strategies.
objective: Create League Overview/Race/News/Stats/Records/Rules plus reusable standings/stat/chart patterns with entity links and accessible data alternatives.
tests: Early/late/playoff standings; mobile priorities; sort/filter; chart alternatives; team/game return origin; old route aliases; long-list performance.
rollback: Legacy routes remain available by tab/route wrapper.
done: Each league question has one canonical section; dense patterns pass phone/desktop/a11y tests.

title: Dynasty and Legacy Story Hub
problem: Twenty-three legacy routes hide emotional payoff in an archive directory.
objective: Create Story/People/Honors/Seasons/Records/Scenarios hub, durable artifacts, and event-driven entry points while preserving every archive route/detail.
tests: First-season empty; record, award, named game, retirement, championship, era transition; artifact links; old route aliases; long history performance.
rollback: Legacy detail routes stay intact; hub/event entries can be disabled independently.
done: 23/23 legacy rows have a canonical section/detail and emotionally timed entry.

title: Save, Recovery, Settings, Accessibility, and Help
problem: Trust-critical settings/save/recovery are overlong and distributed.
objective: Create System entry, Save & Recovery status/actions, categorized settings/accessibility, and help while preserving slots, autosaves, imports/exports, combined backups, and sidecars.
tests: Healthy/saving/failure/quota/import invalid/recovery; complete backup and sidecars; keyboard/zoom/reduced motion; no persistence format change; old utility routes.
rollback: Presentation wraps existing persistence APIs; legacy utilities remain until parity proof.
done: Trust state is legible; destructive scope explicit; all save contracts and recovery fixtures pass.

title: Inline-Style Migration and Legacy Shell Cleanup
deps: All migrated route clusters; runs incrementally
problem: 4,110 direct inline-style blocks and !important responsive overrides prevent stable hierarchy and maintainability.
objective: Migrate layout-critical styles for completed clusters to scoped CSS/semantic tokens, maintain an allowlist, remove obsolete overrides/components only after coverage.
delete: Legacy components/styles only when no route/packet references remain and H2/coverage permits
tests: Count trend; no new layout-critical inline styles; visual regression; grep/reference proof before deletion; bundle comparison.
rollback: Cleanup commits are separated by cluster; revert without changing feature logic.
done: New shell and migrated routes meet style policy; obsolete !important/table-card/Chip-clearance rules removed only when unused.

title: QA, Route Coverage, Performance, and Release Hardening
problem: The overhaul cannot be trusted without deterministic route, viewport, journey, accessibility, visual, save, and performance gates.
objective: Complete automated/manual matrices, final 79/79 proof, visual baselines, performance/bundle checks, device verification, owner playtest script, and release documentation.
tests: Everything in 09 QA document, full project checks, long-running save fixtures, GitHub Pages, offline, device matrix.
rollback: Testing additions do not alter product behavior; release can remain on legacy mode until gates pass.
done: All acceptance thresholds pass; H3 owner script signed; no unaccounted route/feature; rollback mode proven.
